title: 第23章 肖天惨败第24章 象龙神威
content_zh:
“我看大家还是一齐出手吧，早些拿下我们也好离开这里。”
李柔儿看出了萧战的勉强，便打算让大家一块出手。
只是没想到，大家正准备一齐出手时，那三足毒蟾再次张嘴呱了一声，像是在释放什么信号。
随后不等众人明白过来，周围的瘴气中便传来了窸窸窣窣的声音，再接着五六头六重天以上的毒物妖兽从瘴气中走出，将他们包围了起来。
那些妖兽有吐着信子的毒蛇，也有百足的长蜈蚣，更有通体乌黑的毒蝎子……个个蕴含剧毒，境界不低，没有一个是善类。
“怎么有这么多的大型妖兽……”
看到这一幕，有人害怕了起来。
李柔儿更是吃惊，她来时研究过不少关于毒林的信息，只知道三足毒蟾生活在此，根本不知道有这么多其他的妖兽。
这下他们凶多吉少了。
就连一向自负的萧战此时也是眉头紧锁，有了压力。
“肖少队长，这可怎么办啊？这么多妖兽，我们怎么是对手。”
有人紧张得问萧战。
李柔儿此时也是无措了起来，不过她的求助目光却是下意识得看向了江若尘，向江若尘求助。
萧战注意到这一细节，顿感脸上无光，他可是九重天，自认为在队伍中乃是最强的，李柔儿怎么能向江若尘求助？
萧战冷哼一声，赶在江若尘之前道：“三足毒蟾让我来对付，你们保护柔儿姑娘就好，等我杀了三足毒蟾再来救你们！”
“好，好。”
众人连忙点头。
江若尘倒是乐于不出力，只是他看出了萧战气息不稳，像是刚突破了九重天，根本不会是三足毒蟾的对手。
他独自上简直就是浪费时间，于是阻止道：“你不是三足毒蟾的对手，还是交给我来！”
“你说什么？”

萧战本就不服气，听到江若尘这般说更是火气冲天，当即就有跟江若尘大打出手，以此证明自己的架势。
江若尘露出反感的表情，若不是为了大局着想，他根本不会搭理这个萧战！
“这三足毒蟾已经九重天圆满，明显在冲击气海，而你才刚突破九重天，不会是他的对手！
若是耽误时间让它突破成功，今天我们谁也走不掉。”
江若尘道。
“哼，你还是做好你自己分内的事情吧，你别忘了，我才是队长！”
萧战置之不理，急于在李柔儿面前表现的他冷哼一声，再次杀向了三足毒蟾。
呱！
萧战动手的瞬间，三足毒蟾再次发出声音，像是在下达号令，下一秒周围那些妖兽也对江若尘等人发起了攻击。
江若尘盯着杀去的萧战，暗骂一句傻*，转身也去对付其余的妖兽了。
在这种险境，江若尘自然是不会有所保留，五条主脉，以及四十多条暗脉都调动了起来，凝聚最强的四象之力。
那些毒蛇，毒蝎子妖兽大多六七重天的实力，对于队伍其他人来说是很恐怖的，可对江若尘来说就是最好的磨刀石。
以他四象之力的实力，完全就是碾压，但他并未直接用蛮力进行轰杀，而是通过有来有回的交锋，来增加自己的实战经验。
等完全吸收了战斗经验，江若尘才以绝对的实力斩杀掉，转而又掉头去跟其他妖兽过招。
content_en:
"I think everyone should take action together. If we are captured earlier, we can get out of here."
Li Rouer saw Xiao Zhan's reluctance, so she planned to let everyone take action together.
Unexpectedly, when everyone was about to take action together, the three-legged poisonous toad opened its mouth again and croaked, as if it was releasing some signal.
Then, before everyone could understand, a rustling sound came from the surrounding miasma, and then five or six poisonous monsters above the sixth level of heaven came out of the miasma and surrounded them.
Those monster beasts include venomous snakes that spit out poisonous seeds, long centipedes with centipedes, and poisonous scorpions that are completely black... All of them contain highly poisonous and are of high level, and none of them are good.
"Why are there so many large monsters..."
Seeing this scene, some people became scared.
Li Rou'er was even more surprised. She had researched a lot of information about the Poison Forest when she came here. She only knew that the three-legged poison toad lived here, and had no idea that there were so many other monsters.
Now they are in danger.
Even Xiao Zhan, who had always been conceited, was frowning and feeling stressed.
"Captain Xiao, what should we do? There are so many monsters, how can we be opponents?"
Someone asked Xiao Zhan nervously.
Li Rou'er was at a loss at this time, but her eyes for help subconsciously turned to Jiang Ruochen, asking Jiang Ruochen for help.
Xiao Zhan noticed this detail and felt his face was dull. He was from Jiuchongtian and thought he was the strongest in the team. How could Li Rouer ask Jiang Ruochen for help?
Xiao Zhan snorted coldly and said before Jiang Ruochen: "Let me deal with the three-legged poisonous toad. Just protect Miss Rou'er. I will save you after I kill the three-legged poisonous toad!"
"Okay, okay."
Everyone nodded quickly.
Jiang Ruochen was happy not to do anything, but he could see that Xiao Zhan's aura was unstable, as if he had just broken through the ninth heaven, and was no match for the three-legged poison toad.
It was a waste of time for him to go alone, so he stopped him and said, "You are no match for the three-legged poison toad, so you should leave it to me!"
"What did you say?"
Xiao Zhan was not convinced at first, and when he heard what Jiang Ruochen said, he became even more furious. He immediately started a fight with Jiang Ruochen to prove his strength.
Jiang Ruochen showed a disgusted expression. If it wasn't for the sake of the overall situation, he wouldn't pay attention to Xiao Zhan at all!
"This three-legged poisonous toad has reached the ninth level of heaven and is obviously impacting the sea of ​​qi, and you have just broken through the ninth level of heaven, so you will not be his opponent!
If we waste time to allow the breakthrough to succeed, none of us will be able to escape today. "
Jiang Ruochen said.
"Humph, you'd better do your part. Don't forget, I'm the captain!"
Xiao Zhan ignored it. Anxious to show off in front of Li Rouer, he snorted coldly and attacked the three-legged poisonous toad again.
Gua!
The moment Xiao Zhan took action, the three-legged poisonous toad made a sound again, as if giving an order. The next second, the surrounding monsters also launched an attack on Jiang Ruochen and others.
Jiang Ruochen stared at the killed Xiao Zhan, cursed silently, and turned around to deal with the other monsters.
In such a dangerous situation, Jiang Ruochen would naturally not hold anything back. He mobilized the five main veins and more than 40 dark veins to gather the strongest power of the Four Symbols.
Those poisonous snakes, poisonous scorpions and monsters, most of which are in the sixth or seventh heaven, are terrifying to the rest of the team, but they are the best whetstone for Jiang Ruochen.
With the strength of his Four Symbols, it was a complete crushing, but he did not directly use brute force to kill, but increased his actual combat experience through repeated confrontations.
After fully absorbing the combat experience, Jiang Ruochen killed them with absolute strength, then turned around to fight other monsters.
